issues.title: Freeze the endgame artifact vocabulary and owner map
acceptance: One stable vocabulary covers remaining substrate, v14, and v15 artifacts
Every new artifact family has a named owner crate or proposed new owner crate
No duplicate or competing names remain in pack docs

issues.title: Freeze schema publication and compatibility policy through v15
acceptance: Every wire-visible v14/v15 artifact has a draft schema and example fixture
Compatibility windows and additive-vs-breaking policy are explicit
Schema generation owner paths are declared

issues.title: Freeze reference-interpreter obligations before more structs land
acceptance: Reference behavior targets exist for time slicing, widening, bridge atomicity, region replay, carrier diff, experiment comparability, and remote admission/dispute
Test fixture classes are named before implementation drifts

issues.title: Add shared IDs for all remaining v14/v15 artifact families
acceptance: Cross-crate IDs exist for interventions, experiments, counterfactuals, decisions, attestation, trust, admission, remote slices, disputes, and disclosure
No crate-local copies appear for these IDs

issues.title: Close remaining episode/execution/repair substrate gaps before causal and remote layers widen
acceptance: Episode bundle, execution context, runtime provenance, verification plan, and repair record remain the common lane for later work
No v14/v15 artifact bypasses episode or execution lineage where applicable

issues.title: Close remaining regional and algebraic substrate seams that later work depends on
acceptance: Region replay, budget, and typed boundary artifacts exist where v14/v15 need them
Carrier-level diffs and contradiction surfaces are available for later decision traces and remote slices

issues.title: Add v14 intervention and counterfactual artifact families
acceptance: `InterventionBundleV1`, `OutcomeSchemaV1`, `CohortContractV1`, `CounterfactualSliceV1` exist as canonical exportable artifact families
Artifacts preserve episode/time/policy lineage
No narrative-only causal summaries substitute for typed artifacts

issues.title: Add v14 control and policy artifact families
acceptance: `ExperimentCaseV1`, `ComparabilityMatrixV1`, `DecisionTraceV1`, `RefuterSuiteV1`, `RefuterResultV1`, `ExperimentBudgetV1`, `RolloutDecisionV1`, and `RollbackDecisionV1` exist with clear owners
No causal output can become rollout-meaningful without `DecisionTraceV1` and policy references

issues.title: Teach projection storage/query surfaces to preserve v14 artifacts and backpointers
acceptance: Imports preserve intervention/counterfactual/decision lineage
Decision traces backpoint into experiments, cohorts, and replay slices
No broad hidden joins are required to answer causal provenance questions

issues.title: Make runtime disclose cohort and counterfactual-slice semantics
acceptance: Runtime provenance can say what cohort, comparability, and counterfactual slice it used
No silent population drift or hidden widening remains on the causal path

issues.title: Bind bounded exactness and refuter work into kernel/oracle surfaces
acceptance: Bounded exact or stricter experiment evaluators exist for at least one governed path
Refuter outputs preserve replay and exactness metadata

issues.title: Keep pilot/orchestration consumer-only on v14 paths
acceptance: Pilot can schedule interventions/refuters but cannot bypass policy or author truth
Loop receipts expose decision-trace and budget lineage

issues.title: Prove one full v14 path from intervention to rollback-ready decision trace
acceptance: One governed path proves intervention -> cohort -> comparability -> counterfactual slice -> refuter -> decision trace -> rollout/rollback decision
Budget exhaustion yields typed evidence and advisory-only behavior

issues.title: Add attestation and trust-root artifact families with explicit owner crate
acceptance: `AttestationEnvelopeV1`, `TrustRootSetV1`, `TransparencyReceiptV1` exist with a named owner crate
Envelope semantics preserve digest, signer, trust-root, disclosure, and replayability data

issues.title: Add admission, lease, result, replay-ticket, dispute, and disclosure artifact families
acceptance: `ArtifactAdmissionPolicyV1`, `RemoteOracleLeaseV1`, `RemoteSliceRequestV1`, `RemoteSliceResultV1`, `CrossRuntimeReplayTicketV1`, `DisputeBundleV1`, `DisclosurePolicyV1`, and `DisclosureBudgetV1` exist with stable owner mapping
No remote artifact can become meaningful without policy and replay/dispute semantics

issues.title: Preserve attested exchange lineage in import/queryable storage
acceptance: Projection surfaces can answer which envelope, trust-root, admission policy, replay ticket, and dispute state apply
Remote results cannot be flattened into unlabeled local scores

issues.title: Make llm-tool-runtime preserve remote execution evidence rather than provider log folklore
acceptance: Remote execution evidence becomes a typed receipt surface
Provider/tool routes, budget lineage, and replayability class survive handoff

issues.title: Allow pilot to use remote oracles only through leases and admitted artifacts
acceptance: Pilot uses remote oracles only through `RemoteOracleLeaseV1` and admitted result artifacts
No remote score-only path can influence control

issues.title: Land revocation and supersession handling on the exchange path
acceptance: Revocation and supersession become typed artifacts with explicit local invalidation behavior
Silent ignore is impossible on materially important admitted artifacts

issues.title: Prove one full v15 path from local artifact to remote result to dispute or re-admission
acceptance: One governed path proves local artifact -> attested envelope -> transparency receipt -> admission policy -> remote request/result -> replay ticket -> local disposition
One dispute/revoke/re-admit path works without hidden override

issues.title: Declare v15 complete only when the release bar is artifact-complete
acceptance: Release bar includes schema coverage, examples, reference interpreters, replay/dispute proofs, and consumer-only orchestration proof
Docs teach the canonical path rather than the compatibility path
